description: This Java source file defines the LoanPointInTimeData class, which encapsulates a snapshot of various attributes related to a loan at a specific point in time. It includes nested mappings via Mapstruct to convert from a Loan domain object to this data transfer object, covering attributes such as loan details, client details, loan product info, and arrears data.

classes.name: LoanPointInTimeData
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that provides a snapshot of loan, client, product, and arrears attributes at a specific point in time.

classes.name: LoanPointInTimeData.Mapper
classes.description: A Mapstruct mapper interface that defines the mapping configuration and method to convert a Loan domain object into a LoanPointInTimeData DTO.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a Loan domain object to a LoanPointInTimeData DTO, populating fields with corresponding data from the source object.
